name: Light Companion
status: v0, started 2026-11-11. Phones and browsers only.
summary: A small shared light between people. A circle is a few people; each has one light. Lighting yours makes it glow for everyone in the circle. Presence only: no messages, no feed, no accounts.
notice: This is not an emergency or monitoring service. It cannot call for help. A dark window only means a light is not lit.
howItWorks: One tap makes a circle. The circle is identified by a long random link.
Anyone with the link is in. No sign-in, no email, no phone number.
Each member picks a display name and one of six flame colours.
Press and hold your own window to light it. Tap again to snuff it.
A lit light shows the time it was lit and fades on its own at the member's local midnight, or after one hour if they chose that.
A small ember shows the page is connected. When the connection drops, the page says it cannot see the circle and stops showing lights as lit or dark.
isNot: An emergency service, an alarm or a monitor.
A messenger, a feed or a history.
A notification service. Lights are seen when the page is open.

access.model: The circle link is the only key (a capability URL). Anyone holding it can read the circle, join, light or snuff a light, rename, and delete the circle.
access.linkShape: https://pointcast.xyz/light/c/{id} where {id} is 32 characters from a-z and 0-9 (160 random bits)
access.linkHandling: Circle pages are served no-store, noindex and with no referrer. Circle links are never listed in a sitemap or feed. The API takes the id in a header or JSON body, never in a query string.

read.returns: { ok, schema, now, version, store, notice, circle: { createdAt, memberCap, expiresAfterDaysUntouched, members: [{ id, name, colour, mode, lit, litAt, expiresAt }] }, signals: [light signal], drum: { room, page } }
read.notes: now, litAt and expiresAt are UTC milliseconds. litAt and expiresAt are null when a light is not lit. version goes up by one on every change. Poll every 15 seconds or slower; reads are not rate limited. 404 means there is no circle at that link.

actions.join: { action: 'join', circle, name, colour } -> member id
actions.update: { action: 'update', circle, member, name?, colour?, mode? }
actions.light: { action: 'light', circle, member, mode?: 'tonight' | 'hour', until?: UTC ms of the member's local midnight }
actions.put_out: { action: 'put_out', circle, confirm: 'put out' } deletes the circle

perCircle: a one-way hash of the circle link (the link itself is not stored)
each member's display name, flame colour and chosen duration
each member's lit and snuffed times and the time the light fades
when the circle was made and last touched, and a one-minute change counter
stored.createLimit: The limit on new circles is counted against a hash of the caller's address that changes every UTC day. The counter lasts about an hour.
stored.onTheDevice: The browser remembers which member it is for each circle, and the sound setting, in localStorage. 'Leave circle' clears it.

signal.summary: One small event, independent of how it is carried. Today it is carried over HTTP only.

fields.name: circle
fields.meaning: a reference derived from the circle link by a one-way hash; it cannot open the circle

fields.name: member
fields.meaning: the member's id inside the circle, 8 characters

fields.name: expires
fields.meaning: when a lit light fades on its own, UTC milliseconds, at most 26 hours after at; null when snuffed

rules: A signal carries no name, colour, text or location.
For one member the latest at wins; a tie goes to snuffed.
A lit signal past its expires reads as not lit. No expired event is sent.
One encoded signal is at most 200 bytes.
notImplemented: physical places that sense a flame

drum.summary: Each circle has its own room in the existing PointCast drum rooms. The room code is a hash of the circle link, so the room does not reveal the link.

agents.input: { link } — a circle link a person gave you

pageIndex.title: Light Companion
pageIndex.summary: A small shared light between people; presence only, not an emergency or monitoring service.
